name: Tupandactylus
sum: Tapejarid with an enormous sail-like head crest of bone and keratin, from the Crato Formation of Brazil.
wsnote: T. imperator 3–4 m; T. navigans about 2.7 m.
material: Skulls and a very complete T. navigans skeleton (2021).
exceptional: Soft-tissue crest and keratin beak preserved; filament-like integument.
biology: Crest about one third of the wingspan in length; the two species may be sexes of one dimorphic species. Toothless beak.
author: Kellner and Campos 2007
